The '''Chief of State's Suite''' was the group of offices, meeting rooms and private chambers used by the [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. The Chief's Suite was located in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Rotunda]], over 500 meters above the surface of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]] and the conclusion of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], architects from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] rushed to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to begin the reconstruction process, stripping away the remnants of the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]] and restore Coruscant to its prestigious image. Of supreme importance to the fledgling [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] was the reconstruction of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], the symbol of democracy across the stars.<ref name="LOTFBL" />

Installed within the Senate Building was a suite of offices to be used by the Alliance leader, the [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]]. Replacing the old offices of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] in the [[Presidential Tower]] which had not seen use since [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] oversaw the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], this suite ensured that the Chief was up to date on all happenings within the [[Galactic Alliance Senate]].<ref name="LOTFBL" />

The first Chief of State to preside over the Senate in this office was the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Cal Omas]], overseeing its furnishings and occupying the chamber until his arrest in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]] during a [[Solo-Niathal coup|coup]] by [[Supreme Commander]] [[Cha Niathal]] and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]]. Sealing off the office, Solo and Niathal claimed that the chamber would only be occupied by an elected Chief, declaring themselves joint Chiefs of State during the interim.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> After Solo fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and assumed the mantle [[Darth Caedus]], Niathal was deposed and Caedus took up residence in the Chief's office for a brief time following the [[Second Battle of Fondor|second battle]] at [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]]. Caedus' tenure would be brief yet cruel, coming to a sudden end during the [[Battle of Uroro Station|battle]] over [[Shedu Maad]] when he was slain by his sister, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>

With both Caedus and former Chief Omas dead, the Alliance was forced to call for a special election, which saw the unlikely appointment of the notorious [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] installed in the office.<ref name="FOTJO">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>

==Layout==
The Chief of State's suite of offices located within the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] consisted of several rooms and chambers which serviced the leader of the Alliance's needs. The entrance to the inner offices was located within a large, formal reception room, comparable in size to the average residential apartment. A pale blue rug carpeted the floors and chairs were arranged along the walls, while [[Greel wood/Legends|greelwood]] tables with a spread of current popular [[holozine]]s were placed to alleviate some boredom while waiting for an appointment with the Chief. Adorning the walls were large tapestries depicting a menagerie of every imaginable species of animal from across the galaxy. The only other piece of furniture in the room was a desk for the use of the Chief's receptionist, placed directly before the grand, carved double doors leading into the inner office space.<ref name="LOTFBL" />

The largest chamber was the ceremonial office used by the Chief for meetings with large groups of Senators, members of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]], advisers, or other dignitaries. A circular chamber with a large panoramic view of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], the office's decor changed with each passing administration to reflected the aesthetic sensibilities of each sitting Chief. Despite this, each administration retained some of the office's primary features such as the desk of office situated at the head of the room on a slightly raised platform at the top of a small flight of stairs. The desk, which was equipped with data feeds from administrative aides and functionaries, had four chairs placed before it to accommodate guests to the office. A [[Viewscreen/Legends|holoscreen]] was embedded in the wall off to the side of the desk and could be controlled from a command panel in the Chief's chair.<ref name="LOTFBL" />

The carpet of the chamber was blue when occupied by [[Cal Omas]], presenting a calm and soothing atmosphere. Omas kept a group of couches spaced around the sunken meeting area below the desk and a crystal decanter from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] filled with Coruscant water on his desk.<ref name="LOTFBL" /> Following Omas' arrest, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] redecorated the room in natural woods and landscape tones, while [[Cha Niathal]] kept to her military background, keeping the room sparsely decorated in blue and green. Upon the appointment of [[Natasi Daala]], the office was said to resemble the bridge of a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], colored a stark white with several computer monitors lining the walkways and new chairs and desks resembling those used during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="FOTJO" /> Within the suite was a [[Chief of State's Briefing Office|briefing office]] used to hear formal reports from members of the military.<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref>
